flagTips.implausible_value: This value looks impossible. It may be a typing or scanning error. The original is unchanged.
flagTips.gap: Not in your records. This does not mean you don't have it.

landing.title: Other apps summarise your records.
landing.titleAccent: Pramaan knows what it doesn't know.
landing.lead: Prescriptions, lab reports and discharge summaries pile up over the years in different formats, units and dates. Pramaan reads them into one dated timeline where every fact points to the exact line it came from.
landing.docsAlt: Three of Sunita's documents: a 2019 prescription, a 2022 discharge summary and a 2023 prescription, with the important lines highlighted.

notes.conflict: 2019 says "No known drug allergies". 2022 says Penicillin.
notes.copy: Atenolol line copied word for word from 2019
notes.change: A real change: Metformin dose doubled

trail.title: Sunita's file: 7 papers, 5 years
trail.lead: Sunita is the synthetic patient in our demo. Almost every paper hides a trap that a fluent summary walks straight past.

d6.trap: Exact duplicate of the one before

compare.title: Same records, two readings
compare.summaryText: Sunita, 70, has type 2 diabetes and takes Metformin, Atenolol and Amlodipine. No known drug allergies. Fasting glucose rose from 6.8 to 122.
compare.summaryNote: Fluent and confident. You cannot tell which parts are true.

atenolol.name: Atenolol 50mg OD
atenolol.text: Last real evidence 2019. The 2022 and 2023 mentions are copies.

allergy.name: Allergies
allergy.text: "No known drug allergies" (2019) and "Penicillin (rash)" (2022) disagree. Sent to the doctor to settle.

glucose.name: Fasting glucose
glucose.text: 6.8 mmol/L and 122 mg/dL use different units. Both shown as written, not compared.

psa.name: PSA report, 04/05/2023
psa.text: Male, blood group B+. Held back: probably another patient.

compare.sourceHint: Each line opens the page and line it came from.

inside.title: Inside Pramaan

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.text: Every row links to its source line. Conflicts are flagged for a person to settle, never settled quietly.

medication.title: Medication
medication.text: Copies count once. Each medicine shows the date of its last real evidence.

inside.timelineAlt: Pramaan's timeline for Sunita: a Penicillin allergy in 2022 and "No known drug allergies" in 2019, both flagged as a contradiction.
inside.medicationAlt: Pramaan's medication view: Metformin, Atenolol and Amlodipine, with copied mentions marked as copies.

landing.privacyLead: Built following the safeguards of GDPR, the EU AI Act and India's DPDP Act.

privacy.deid: Names, phone numbers and IDs removed before any AI call
privacy.audit: Audit log of who saw what
privacy.delete: Delete all your data at any time

landing.closing: A fluent summary asks you to trust it. Pramaan gives you a history you can verify.
landing.footerDemo: Demo with synthetic patient data only.
